title: Generalise over the schedule, then instantiate at the certified one: Navier-Stokes local theorem
intent: The parent `local_theorem` asserts the existence of fields realising the paper's full `Properties` structure with no schedule hypotheses left. The decomposition builds that structure once for an arbitrary schedule (`properties_of_schedule`), obtains one concrete certified schedule (`selected_schedule`), and instantiates the general result at it.
also_known_as: prove the general statement then specialise

parent.name: local_theorem
parent.statement:
theorem local_theorem :
    ∃ h qstar Xa Xext heatNormalization : ℝ,
      ∃ A D u : VelocityField, ∃ p : PressureField,
        Properties h qstar Xa Xext heatNormalization A D u p

theorem properties_of_schedule {a : ℕ → ℕ} (hs : LocalScheduleWitness.Selected a)
    (hr : LocalResidualFlatness.AllResidualJetRates ActualPrimary.h
      ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPotentialStages ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedDirectStages
      ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPressureStages a) :
    Properties ActualPrimary.h (LocalPaperDomain.qstar a) LocalPaperDomain.innerEdge

children.name: selected_schedule
children.statement:
theorem selected_schedule :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      MixedCandidateWitness.SelectedSchedule CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h
        ActualCandidateConstruction.selectedQbig ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPotentialStages
        ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedDirectStages ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPressureStages a ∧
      MixedDiagonalSchedule.ThreeCutBounds a CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h
        ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPotentialStages ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedDirectStages
        ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPressureStages (fun j => selectedEstimates.gain j / 2)
        (MixedDiagonalSchedule.commonLoss selectedEstimates.potentialLoss selectedEstimates.directLoss
          selectedEstimates.pressureLoss) PhysicalWaveSum.preterminal ∧
      AllResidualJetRates CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h
        ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPotentialStages ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedDirectStages
        ActualCandidateAssembly.selectedPressureStages a
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: There exists a schedule a carrying the SelectedSchedule witness, ThreeCutBounds and AllResidualJetRates for the repository's fixed selected estimates (analyst's paraphrase, to be replaced by the declaration's text).

applicability.goal_shape: An existence goal `∃ x : σ, P x` where `P` is a big conjunction (a structure) that can be built for any element of a class, from a small set of hypotheses on that element.
applicability.use_when: The heavy structure is assembled once, parameterised by an element `a` of a class (here any schedule with a `Selected` witness and all-order residual rates); a separate lemma certifies a concrete element; the glue is then one `obtain` plus one application of the general lemma.
applicability.avoid_when: The class is too weak to carry the proof, so the generalised statement does not close; the concrete element must be used in incompatible ways in different clauses (generalising then loses information); or the generalisation forces re-deriving per-instance side conditions that the concrete case would have discharged directly.

metrics.how_counted: parent = lines 178-184 of NavierStokes/LocalPaperTheorem.lean; children = properties_of_schedule lines 126-176 and selected_schedule lines 111-129; each child closes by an explicit structure or a named lemma application, not by a single automation tactic (simp/aesop/omega).

consequences: The move splits the existence proof into a general lemma (all the mathematics, over a free variable `a`) and a certificate lemma (existence of one concrete instance). Obligations: the general lemma's hypotheses must be discharged exactly once at the instantiation site, and the certified element must satisfy the same hypothesis type as the general lemma's parameter (here `Selected a` and `AllResidualJetRates`). Failure mode: if the certificate's conclusion is weaker than or differently shaped from the general lemma's hypotheses, the `obtain` pattern breaks and the glue must re-derive hypotheses by hand.
